body: Land Use Committee - City Council Committee
name: Land Use Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  LAND USE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 6, 2024 – 3:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model.  The Public may join this meeting virtually or
attend in-person at City Hall.

Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
11:00 a.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Land Use Committee
Members prior to the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-
Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:.
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86047747922
  Webinar ID: 860 4774 7922
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,86047747922# OR +16699009128,,86047747922#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Committee Chair.
The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to speak must “raise their hand”, at
which time they will be unmuted.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
Committee-Supplemental-Packets
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Davis, Councilmember Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Land Use Committee on items not on the printed agenda and within
the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.
Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit to City Staff prior to the meeting starting.

BUSINESS:

1.  Planned Development Permit No. 22-001
  Applicant: Jose Tamayo
  Project Address: 4061 Lakeview Canyon Road
  Project Description: Review of a revised site plan for the parking lot of the County
  Line Shopping Center for recent changes to meet ADA requirements including the
  replacement of a trash enclosure.

2.  Conditional Use Permit No. 18-013, Modification No. 2
  Applicant: David Coffey
  Project Address: 31139 Via Colinas, Suite 210
  Project Description: Request for an extension of the permit term to authorize the
  continued operation of an escape room.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, February 29, 2024 at 5:15 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  February 29, 2024
